title: The Oral Tradition of Storytelling
skills: explain how stories are preserved through oral tradition
analyze how culture and values are transmitted through stories
connect oral traditions to later written literature
alignment_note: Introduces oral tradition as a way communities preserve and transmit stories, history, beliefs, and cultural values across generations. Supports literary-historical understanding, cultural analysis, narrative study, and connections between spoken storytelling traditions and written literature across high school English courses.
